fato_historico: 2022: Liz Truss steps down as British Prime Minister and leader of the Conservative Party amid the country's political crisis, serving for the least time of any British Prime Minister (49 days).
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find balance, dear Libra. Much like a fleeting chapter in history that reminds us how quickly winds of change can shift, you may feel an urge to reset. It is a good time to release what no longer serves your peace and consider new ways to cultivate stability in your beautiful, diplomatic life.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found when you let go of what is temporary.
significado_numero: A reflection of cycles, endings, and the beauty of new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your intuition and prioritize your peace over maintaining outdated expectations today.
